absent.note: AADSTS50126 is an invalid-credentials code, not one of the token or session codes of this domain.
The same look-alike code; it is not an MFA or Conditional Access result.

annotations.rationale: An expired password after leave, resolved by a self-service reset. The case contains no scope statement, no server-side evidence statement and no diagnostic step from the vocabulary; the quoted AADSTS code looks similar to the codes the domain cares about but is not one of them. The engineer reassures, explains and fixes it in one round.
